findings.issue: もの is labeled as the copula that closes ～ものだ, and its note even calls it 'forma neutra da cópula だ'. もの is a formal noun/nominalizer, not a copula; the actual copula is the following だ (tokens[7]), which was left with null gloss/role.
findings.current: cópula que fecha o padrão ～ものだ, antes da citação と

findings.issue: Gloss 'it is (that's the case)' (pt 'é (era o caso)') belongs to the copula だ, not to the noun もの — annotations of もの and the following だ are swapped. The pt gloss and the note ('plain form of the copula だ') carry the same defect.
findings.suggested: thing (formal noun of the ～ものだ pattern)

findings.issue: This だ (right after 死ん) is the voiced past-tense marker た completing 死んだ (past of 死ぬ), not a nominalizer of ～ものだ. Token annotations are shifted by one: the ものだ elements are the following もの+だ.
findings.suggested: auxiliar de passado (た sonorizado em だ, fechando 死んだ)

findings.issue: Gloss describes this だ as an element of the ～ものだ pattern, but it is the past-tense inflection of 死ぬ (死んだ). The pt gloss '(elemento do padrão ～ものだ: 'que (estava)')' has the same defect.
findings.suggested: (past-tense marker: voiced た closing 死んだ)
